text:
Your doctor never told you this about antidepressants.

What actually happens:

1. The pill mutes the pain in week one.
2. Your body adapts. You need more to feel the same.
3. The root cause keeps rotting underneath.
4. You stop the pill. The problem is still there, louder.

No prescription fixes a life you are not willing to change.

Start the work today. Discomfort is the only real cure.
caption:
The pill changes how you feel. Discipline and self improvement change who you are. Only one of those is real.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
